test_cases.description: Verify that a new task is created successfully when a valid TaskCreate payload is provided.
test_cases.name: create_task_with_valid_payload

test_setup.given: No existing tasks in the system.
test_setup.then: A new task is created and returned with a 201 status.
test_setup.when: A POST request is sent with a valid TaskCreate payload.

test_cases.description: Verify that the API returns a 422 error when the required 'title' field is missing.
test_cases.name: create_task_missing_required_field

test_setup.given: No existing tasks in the system.
test_setup.then: The request fails with a 422 status and appropriate error message.
test_setup.when: A POST request is sent without the required 'title' field.

test_cases.description: Verify that the API returns an error when the 'title' field is provided as an empty string.
test_cases.name: create_task_with_empty_title

test_setup.given: No existing tasks in the system.
test_setup.then: The request fails with a 422 status and validation error.
test_setup.when: A POST request is sent with an empty 'title' field.

test_cases.description: Verify that a task is created successfully when the 'title' field is at its maximum allowed length.
test_cases.name: create_task_with_max_length_title

test_setup.given: No existing tasks in the system.
test_setup.then: A new task is created and returned with a 201 status.
test_setup.when: A POST request is sent with 'title' at maximum allowed length.

test_cases.description: Verify that the API returns a 422 error when the 'due_date' field is not in valid YYYY-MM-DD format.
test_cases.name: create_task_invalid_due_date_format

test_setup.given: No existing tasks in the system.
test_setup.then: The request fails with a 422 error and validation message.
test_setup.when: A POST request is sent with an invalid 'due_date' format.

test_cases.description: Verify that the API ignores extra fields not defined in TaskCreate.
test_cases.name: create_task_with_extra_fields

test_setup.given: No existing tasks in the system.
test_setup.then: The task is created and the extra field is ignored.
test_setup.when: A POST request is sent with valid fields and an extra 'priority' field.

test_cases.description: Verify that the API returns a 422 error when the request body is missing.
test_cases.name: create_task_with_no_body

test_setup.given: No existing tasks in the system.
test_setup.then: The API returns a 422 error indicating the body is required.
test_setup.when: A POST request is sent without a body.

test_cases.description: Verify that the API returns a 415 error when the body is not valid JSON.
test_cases.name: create_task_with_non_json_body

test_setup.given: No existing tasks in the system.
test_setup.when: A POST request is sent with a non-JSON body.

test_cases.description: Verify that the API prevents creation of duplicate tasks if duplicates are not allowed.
test_cases.name: create_task_duplicate_task

response_body_json.detail: Task with the same title and due date already exists

test_setup.given: A task with title 'Buy groceries' and due date '2024-06-25' already exists.
test_setup.then: The API rejects the request with a 409 status.
test_setup.when: A POST request is sent with the same title and due date.

test_cases.description: Verify that a task is created successfully when the 'title' field is at the minimum allowed length.
test_cases.name: create_task_with_min_length_title

test_setup.given: No existing tasks in the system.
test_setup.then: A new task is created and returned with a 201 status.
test_setup.when: A POST request is sent with 'title' at the minimum allowed length.

test_cases.description: Verify that a task can be created with required fields only and optional fields missing.
test_cases.name: create_task_optional_fields_missing

test_setup.given: No existing tasks in the system.
test_setup.then: A new task is created, and optional fields are set to default/null values.
test_setup.when: A POST request is sent with only the required 'title' field.
